H3 detaches the specified actor from the current script. A Reach abort command script may stop behavior but is not proven to restore identical ownership or queue state.
H3 detaches all actors owned by the current thread. The explicit-AI Reach cs calls do not establish a replacement for this thread-owned set. Never delete this call automatically.

H3 assigns actor ownership to the current script with priority and discards queued command scripts. Reach cs_run_command_script replaces a command script but does not document the same ownership/priority contract. No safe rename or no-op is established.
